description:
Project Overview

Wageningen University & Research is investigating how moss traits influence fire ignition in peatlands and tundra. The doctorate connects plant ecology with the changing fire vulnerability of high-latitude ecosystems.

Research Position Overview

Measure moss ignitability in laboratory experiments, undertake high-latitude fieldwork and connect observations with remote sensing and global vegetation databases. The work is based in Plant Ecology and Nature Conservation, within the Vegetation–Climate Feedbacks research area.

Research Areas

  • Moss functional traits
  • Fire ignition
  • Peatland
  • Tundra
